profile.name: 规则任务调度服务器
profile.description: 非物理软件组件，用于在 PYME 集群分析流程中按规则生成和发布任务，接收计算节点竞价，释放或停用任务规则，并汇总任务完成状态。适用于显微成像等实验数据的分布式处理与工作流调度。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component that generates and advertises tasks according to rules in a PYME cluster workflow, accepts bids from compute nodes, releases or inactivates task rules, and collects task completion results. It is used for distributed processing and workflow scheduling of experimental data such as microscopy analysis.
